text: No, the property was not fully cleared in 2021. Only 81.3 hectares (2.23% of the 3643.5-hectare property) experienced tree-cover loss that year, according to the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset. The loss area was mostly planted forest (68.1 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), with a small fraction (13.2 ha) outside mapped forest zones. Additional small losses (37.3 ha) in patches under 0.5 ha were not classified as events. The majority of the asset remained unchanged.
